description: This file defines the EndpointDiscoveryMiddleware class used for handling endpoint discovery logic in AWS SDK PHP, including caching, endpoint resolution, and error handling.

classes.name: Aws\EndpointDiscovery\\EndpointDiscoveryMiddleware
classes.description: Middleware class for managing AWS endpoint discovery, including caching, endpoint resolution, and error handling.

methods.name: wrap
methods.description: Static method to create a middleware wrapper around a client, args, and config.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing handler, client, args, service, and config.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Main method invoked to process a command and request, handling endpoint discovery logic.

methods.name: discoverEndpoint
methods.description: Discovers an endpoint via a discovery command and updates cache.

methods.name: getCacheKey
methods.description: Generates a cache key based on credentials, command, and identifiers.

methods.name: getDiscoveryCommand
methods.description: Creates a command to perform endpoint discovery.

methods.name: getIdentifiers
methods.description: Extracts identifiers from operation input shape for endpoint discovery.

methods.name: handleDiscoveryException
methods.description: Handles exceptions during endpoint discovery, throwing or reverting to original URI.

methods.name: handleInvalidEndpoint
methods.description: Handles invalid endpoints by removing from cache and retrying discovery if needed.

methods.name: modifyRequest
methods.description: Modifies the request URI and headers with the discovered endpoint.

methods.name: parseEndpoint
methods.description: Parses a URL endpoint into host and path components.

methods.name: useOriginalUri
methods.description: Uses the original URI if endpoint discovery fails or is not required.
